Before proceeding further, it would be appropriate to go through Section 311 of Code of Criminal Procedure (Section 348 of BNSS), which for the sake of convenience con is reproduced hereinbelow:
hereinbelow:-
"Section 311. Power to summon material witness, or examine person present.

Any Court may, at any stage of any inquiry, trial or other proceeding under this Code,
summon any person as a witness, 4 of 7 or examine any person in attendance, though not summoned as a witness, or recall and re re-examine examine any person already examined; and the Court shall summon and examine or recall and re-examine examine any such person if his evidence appears to it to be essential to the just decision of the case.
case."

Section 311 Cr.P.C. empowers the Court at any stage of inquiry, trial or other proceeding to summon any person as a witness, or to recall and re-examine re amine any person already examined, or to place on record any document, if his evidence appears to be essential to the just decision of the case.
